Compute base grouped rotation summary (expensive step)

Source: R/functions.R
compute_rotation_base_grouped.Rd

Groups raw rotation data by rotation pattern and sums areas. This is the expensive operation that should be cached and reused when calling transform_rotation_summary multiple times with the same data and area_range.

compute_rotation_base_grouped(All_rot_big, area_range, years)

Arguments

All_rot_big

Data frame with rotation data

area_range

Numeric vector of length 2 (min, max area)

years

Numeric vector of years

Value

A data.table with grouped rotation summaries
